system_name: V1 monocular columns with cross-inhibition and adaptation
description: Two excitatory populations in early visual cortex, each driven by one eye's input via ocular-dominance columns, compete through reciprocal inhibition mediated by shared GABAergic interneurons. Recurrent excitation within each population sustains the dominant percept, while calcium-activated K+ currents produce spike-frequency adaptation that slowly fatigues the dominant pool. Background noise then allows the suppressed population to escape inhibition, generating stochastic perceptual alternations with gamma-distributed dominance durations.
